commonPrompt: Premium dark grim pixel-art video game cover key art in the established Dungeon Escape style, more caricatured and heroic than a quiet environment study: exaggerated readable silhouettes, strong action diagonals, dynamic perspective, richer biome accents, low-resolution hand-painted pixel blocks, deep near-black shadows, restrained practical light, strong material texture, no text, no logo, no border, no UI, no watermark. The same small faceless round-headed adventurer in a ragged black cloak is always visible. Main images show the adventurer clearly running away from a varied trio of real biome enemies in a chase, with hero, enemies, and landmark on the right and the left third dark and low-detail for an HTML menu card. Ending images show the same adventurer reaching the biome exit while a different varied trio of real biome enemies remains behind in shadow, with the exit and hero on the left and the right third dark and low-detail for an HTML results card.
